title: toaster oven
text: toaster oven. I purchased this as a gift for my daughter.  She reports that is "awesome!"  Like a second oven.  It's big and useful for her family of 4.  This is NOT a compact toaster oven - is very big with a significant footprint on the counter - but if you have a family and a large kitchen - it's just want the doctor ordered!  It appears to be sturdy.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Oster Air Fryer Oven, 10-in-1 Countertop Toaster Oven Air Fryer Combo, 10.5" x 13" Fits 2 Large Pizzas, Stainless Steel
features: Extra-large capacity cooks a full meal, main, and sides, all at once; fits 2 large pizzas, 2 full chickens, or three 10.5 x 13-inch baking pans
Air fryer has a faster and more powerful fan to circulate hot air, adding a delicious crisp to all your favorite recipes with little to no oil (compared to 3.7 L deep fryers)
Easy-to-use digital controls provide precise cooking times and temperatures to take the guesswork out of cooking, and a manual 90-minute timer
Features 10 versatile cooking functions including Air Fry, Bake, Dehydrate, Toast, Broil, Roast, Keep Warm, Pizza, Turbo Convection and TenderRoast to easily cook your favorite foods
TenderRoast function effortlessly cooks meat to tender and juicy perfection, and also slow roasts up to 12 hours
3 rack positions accommodate a wide variety of foods and allow for multilevel cooking
Includes an air fry rack, wire/broil rack, durable baking pan, and removable crumb tray
description: The Oster® Extra-Large Air Fry Oven combines extra-large capacity with great features to make it easier to cook multiple meals and sides at once. This digital air fryer features 7 versatile cooking functions including air fry, bake, toast, broil, roast, warm, and pizza that allow you to easily cook your favorite foods. Take the guesswork out of cooking with the easy-to-use digital controls that automatically program time and temperature or use the manual 90-minute timer. For optimal air frying, this oven includes a faster, more powerful fan that circulates hot air so you can add a delicious crisp to all your fried favorites, with little to no oil!* The extra-large capacity and 3 rack positions allow you to cook multiple meals at once. Fit up to 2 large pizzas, 2 full chickens, or three 10.5 x 13-inch baking pans, so you can cook your main dishes and sides simultaneously. The durable stainless steel finish and modern design looks great in every kitchen. Also includes an air fry rack, wire/broil rack, durable baking pan, and removable crumb tray. *compared to 3.7 L deep fryers
